Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
characterization

Cast rough particle films on acetone-cleaned glass

Cast rough particle films on acetone-cleaned glass. Drop-cast hexane dispersions onto acetone-cleaned glass coverslips to make a rough film. This is not a separate synthesis recipe or a measured film thickness. Missing fields: film thickness.

No separate quantity entered here; consult stocks, operations and source notes below.

Environment: Not reportedEndpoint: Not reported
Material flow & source

Outputs: lifetime-film

Depends on: Independent preparation / input state

ghosh2012 · MAIN PDF p. 2 (printed 9635), Lifetime Measurements; source SHA256 a624fe12df46fdfb6101824ec0836522ccd6bff10aa663c2379316001e175d96
02
characterization

Acquire TCSPC, fit triexponentials and report mean lifetime

Acquire TCSPC, fit triexponentials and report mean lifetime. Use PicoQuant LDH-P-C-405B pulsed excitation, wide-field illumination and neutral-density attenuation. The stated optical-power regime is several nW to hundreds of pW, not exact interval endpoints. Collect through a 100×, NA 1.3 oil-immersion objective, dichroic and long-pass filter; use Perkin-Elmer SPCM-AQR-14 SPAD and PicoQuant PicoHarp 300 TCSPC. Igor Pro fits triexponential histograms and computes the reported average lifetime from amplitude and lifetime coefficients. The eighteen rows report mean fit coefficients and mean average lifetimes for four core sizes. Amplitude coefficients are normalized, but displayed rounding and averaging need not reproduce exact unity or exact average lifetime from the printed mean coefficients. Initial guesses strongly affect individual components, less the converged mean lifetime. Missing fields: raw fit files.
